sources.title: GitHub - viiika/Latent-Adapter
sources.snippet: Introduction we present IP-Adapter, an effective and lightweight adapter to achieve image prompt capability for the pre-trained text-to-image diffusion models. An IP-Adapter with only 22M parameters can achieve comparable or even better performance to a fine-tuned image prompt model.
